d:
Anant Singh’s gamble—which even included having *rasgullas* prepared in anticipation of a victory—backfired. In the very election where he had set out to ensure the defeat of his own party’s candidate, it was JDU’s Neeraj Kumar who emerged victorious. Anant Singh had thrown his full weight behind the Jan Suraj candidate, Anuj Singh, going so far as to have several quintals of rasgullas made at his home. However, when the results were declared, it was Neeraj Kumar who won. Now, Neeraj Kumar is taking digs at Anant Singh.
